meta.title: Trinity Marketing Scorecard
meta.subtitle: Synthesis Brief impact: Accept → ship on paradigmlife.net → did the funnel move?
how_to_use: Monday: log Surfaced / Accept / Defer / Kill from the Synthesis Brief into that week (this is the missing Accept ritual).
When an Accept ships, paste the live paradigmlife.net URL (match by topic/slug — not UTM).
Friday: fill funnel cells for those URLs and set Impact Yes / Mixed / No + next change.
Judge the Brief on Accept→Ship rate and time-to-ship first; page sessions second; MQLs only with honest attribution limits.
meta.attribution: Brief impact is three layers: (1) did THE ONE THING / content items get Accepted, (2) did Accepts ship on paradigmlife.net, (3) did those ships move sessions or MQLs. Primary proof for (2) is brief topic ↔ live URL. First/last HubSpot URL will not credit mid-path blog ships; UTMs (trinity_brief_*) are an optional assist and currently read 0.
sources: Synthesis Briefs (Drive, dtorsak): weekly force-rank Jul 20–Sep 21 2026 — THE ONE THING is usually paid/SDR; content/SEO items mid-list
Brief→ship map (60d): content recommendations recur; matching paradigmlife.net lastmods land within ~1–3 weeks for several SEO/title/cluster items
HubSpot MQLs sample ~300 contacts Jul 27–Sep 23 window: 0 first/last URL on scorecard ships; learn.paradigmlife.net paid LPs dominate; trinity_brief_* UTMs = 0
GA4 site sessions via CMO Weekly Marketing Summary (reports@ → Drive) for completed weeks
Google Ads clicks/CTR via Metricool brand Paradigm Life (week-matched)
GA4 pagePath sessions via Gauge mcp-ga4 property 256670786 (ruby-drive-access SA)
blockers: Accept / Defer / Kill ritual not logged in scorecard counts (null) — cannot score Brief compliance without Monday Accepts
HubSpot first/last URL never credits mid-funnel blog ships; need path/session stitching or UTMs for MQL proof
Week sitewide sessions still from CMO Weekly Marketing Summary; pagePath from Gauge mcp-ga4 property 256670786
Gauge still owed full 8-week pagePath matrix for all 21 ships (Sep 14 six-path sum=48 filled)

brief_impact.headline: Operating impact in the content lane is visible; funnel (MQL) impact is not provable yet.

layers.note: THE ONE THING week after week is paid-search caps or SDR technique — not content. Accept/Defer/Kill counts are still null on the board.

Across Aug–Sep briefs, content/SEO items (title/meta refreshes, generational-wealth cluster, IBC intercept, non-correlated-assets rebuild, cash-flow consolidation) keep reappearing and matching paradigmlife.net URLs pick up lastmods within ~1–3 weeks. Sep 14 week alone shipped 6 URLs (~48 pagePath sessions). ~half of the 21 ships in the 60d sitemap window can be topic/path-linked to a brief item.

HubSpot sample through paging (~300 MQLs in window): 0 first-URL and 0 last-URL matches to scorecard ships. Hosts are ~90%+ learn.paradigmlife.net paid LPs (/infinite-banking-1/, etc.). Brief-assisted UTMs = 0. Page sessions on ships exist but are a thin slice of sitewide (~48 vs ~2,872 for Sep 14).

what_would_change_the_call: Log Monday Accept/Defer/Kill against Brief #s (unlocks layer 1).
Keep shipping Accepts with live URLs (strengthens layer 2).
Add mid-path or trinity_brief_* capture before calling MQL impact (unlocks layer 3).
